text:
Harper: Quick flag  a recruiter noticed several interviewers showing as "not certified" in the ATS even though they completed the "Interview Calibration" course yesterday. This caused the scheduler to skip them when building panels. Reported at 08:15.

Diego: Which interviewers? any pattern?

Harper: 5 people from cohort C12 (contractor batch). LMS shows completion time 2026-03-22T19:02:00Z. ATS user profile still has `calibration_completed=false`.

Maya: I pulled the webhook delivery logs from the LMS. It sent completion events but payload used string values rather than booleans. example:

```
{
  "user_email": "alex+ctr@redwood.com",
  "course": "interview_calibration",
  "completed": "true",
  "completed_at": "2026-03-22T19:02:00Z"
}
```
Ivy: Ah yes  our ATS schema expects `completed` as boolean. The receiver code does a strict type check and defaults to false when not a boolean. That explains it.

Diego: Is the LMS change recent? We haven't changed that mapping in months.

Maya: The LMS vendor rolled a minor patch yesterday that moved all boolean fields to be strings for compatibility with their new event pipeline. We missed the vendor release note.

Harper: Recruiters are blocked from scheduling some panels until this is fixed. Short-term mitigation?

Ivy: Quick patch we can do in the ATS webhook handler: coerce string "true"/"false" to booleans, and also accept "1"/"0". I'll open a small PR to change the deserializer to be permissive.

Diego: Good. Also add a defensive audit log that records original payload and the normalized value so we can spot other vendors doing this.

Maya: I'll contact LMS support to request they revert or add a boolean field alongside strings. But we shouldn't block on them.

Harper: For the affected interviewers, can we run a one-off backfill to set `calibration_completed=true` in ATS so they can be scheduled today?

Ivy: Yes. I can run a backfill script after merging the PR. The script will: query LMS events for course=interview_calibration and set ATS.user.calibration_completed=true where course.completed in ["true","True","1"] and completed_at > now-2d.

Maya: Outline for running backfill: 1) merge permissive parser PR (staging) 2) run backfill in staging, sanity check 3) deploy to prod 4) run prod backfill 5) notify recruiting.

Diego: ETA?

Ivy: Parser PR in 20m, tests included. Backfill ready to run after deploy; should take ~15m for the affected cohort. I'll post PR links.

ops-bot: Reminder: open ticket "Backfill: CalibrationFlagSync" and attach runbook + expected row count. Include recruiter contact.

Harper: I'll open the ticket and include affected interviewers + list of panels needing reschedule. Also will message recruiters with the workaround (manually mark certified in UI).

Maya: I'll escalate to LMS account manager to get a permanent fix on their side and ask for release notes notifications.

Diego: Long-term: add schema validation to our LMS webhook contract tests and a synthetic test that sends string booleans to the handler in CI so we catch changes earlier.

Ivy: Agree. Adding test and a small dashboard metric "lms.payload-type-mismatch" that increments on deserialization mismatches.

Harper: Thanks all. Reopen if anything surprises us after the backfill. :white_check_mark:
